description: This file defines an abstract class 'HardRefCacheLine' which extends 'CacheLine' and manages a cache line with a hard reference to a value of generic type V. It provides a constructor to initialize the cache line with a value, load time, and expiration time, and a method to retrieve the value.

classes.name: HardRefCacheLine
classes.description: An abstract class representing a cache line that holds a hard reference to a value of type V, with mechanisms to set load and expiration times.

methods.name: HardRefCacheLine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache line with a value, load time, and expiration time.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the cached value held in this cache line.
